name: External Rejected Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for a rejected status|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately. External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

BDAY.name: Not Business Day
BDAY.definition: Date is not a business day

DPRG.name: Rejected Since In Progress
DPRG.definition: Request has been rejected because the instruction process is in progress or has been processed

INDT.name: Invalid Details
INDT.definition: Some message details specified in the instruction/request are inconsistent with those that expected

MISM.name: Invalid Request
MISM.definition: The request cannot be executed. The message requested is not valid

NAUT.name: Not Authorised
NAUT.definition: Permission to be processed is not granted

NOAC.name: No Access To Service
NOAC.definition: Client has no access to the service

ASBR.name: Acknowledgement Of Settlement Batch Received
ASBR.definition: Acknowledgement of settlement batch received from PSO for settlement.

AB15.name: Invalid Account Number For Settlement Type
AB15.definition: Settlement Instruction with invalid account number or specific settlement type.

AB12.name: Invalid Concurrent Batch Settlement Instruction Sequence Number
AB12.definition: Process a Batch Removal Instruction with an incorrect Batch Concurrent Sequence.

DT07.name: Invalid Creation Date
DT07.definition: Process a Batch Removal Instruction with an incorrect "Original Creation Date and Time" for the batch.

AB13.name: Invalid Routing Code Utilised
AB13.definition: Invalid routing code send by participant to settlement operator.

AB21.name: Invalid Settlement Agreement Number Specified
AB21.definition: Processing interbank batch settlement instruction with invalid agreement number for settlement type.

ISWS.name: Invalid Settlement Window
ISWS.definition: Invalid settlement window for settlement instruction.

NOFR.name: Outstanding Funding For Settlement
NOFR.definition: Warning messages that is send to participants when settlement account must be funded.

RC14.name: Participant In BCP No CLS Instructions Allowed
RC14.definition: Participant is in BCP no settlement instruction for CLS.

RC16.name: Participant Not Active Member Of SADCRTGS
RC16.definition: Originator of the instruction is not an active participant in SADC RTGS.

RC15.name: Participant Not Active Member Settlement Type
RC15.definition: Participant is not an active member of a specific settlement type.

RC13.name: Participant Not An Active Member Of RTGS
RC13.definition: Originator of the instruction is not an active participant in RTGS.

SBRN.name: Settlement Batch Removal Notification
SBRN.definition: Settlement batch removal notification due to batch not funded at window closure by participants.
